elements.title: The Shift from Recurrence to Attention
elements.subtitle: Replacing Recurrence with Attention Mechanisms
bullets: RNNs are limited by sequential computation bottlenecks.
Transformers rely entirely on attention for global dependencies.
Architecture enables massive parallelization and faster training.

builds.audio_segment: Traditional RNNs are limited by sequential computation.
RNNs are limited by sequential computation bottlenecks.
The Transformer replaces recurrence with attention, enabling massive parallelization. Transformers rely entirely on attention for global dependencies.
This architecture achieves state-of-the-art translation quality while training in a fraction of the time. Architecture enables massive parallelization and faster training.
